PRIVACY NOTICE

Respect for your
information.

A straightforward explanation of how we collect, use and protect information.

Information you provide

When you contact the firm or apply for a career opportunity, we may collect the information you choose to provide, such as your name, contact details, professional background, preferred office, résumé or profile link, and the contents of your message.

How we use your information

We use this information to respond to enquiries, assess applications, communicate with you and provide the assistance or information you request. We do not use the information submitted through these forms for unrelated marketing.

How we protect your information

We take reasonable steps to protect the information you provide from unauthorised access, use or disclosure. Please do not send confidential financial records, identity documents, passwords or other sensitive material through a general website form.

How long we keep information

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by applicable professional, legal or recordkeeping obligations.

Your choices and questions

You may contact us at office@psbassociates.in to ask about the personal information you have shared with us, or to request correction or deletion where appropriate. Some requests may be subject to legal or professional requirements.

Cookies and third-party content

This website may use essential cookies and privacy-respecting analytics where enabled. Pages may also include maps, fonts or links provided by third parties, which operate under their own privacy policies.
